1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto exclusivo de Puerto Rico que se da en los bosques montañosos. Su tronco es fino y su corteza gris y lisa aunque levemente agrietada y ligeramente amarga. Sus hojas son ovaladas, medianas. Da flores blancas, tubulares, en tallos con pequeños racimos que salen de la base de las hojas. Echa una cápsula de color gris castaño con pelitos conteniendo muchas semillas largas y pequeñas. Su madera sólo sirve para combustible.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrubby tree exclusive to Puerto Rico found in mountainous forests. Its trunk is slender and its gray, smooth bark is slightly cracked and mildly bitter. Its leaves are oval-shaped and medium-sized. It produces white, tubular flowers on stalks with small clusters that emerge from the base of the leaves. It yields a brownish-gray capsule with hairs containing many long and small seeds. Its wood serves only for fuel.
